title: Aftercode
shortDescription: Aftercode > Autonomous Repository Analysis, Next.js App Router Workspace & Programmatic Remotion Media Engine ![npm version](https://www.npmjs.com/package/aftercode) ![License: MIT...
description: **Aftercode** is a **real‑time collaborative coding platform** built with a **React/Next.js** front‑end and a **WebSocket‑based** back‑end. It leverages **Gemini AI** for on‑the‑fly code suggestions and refactoring, orchestrated through a modular service layer that isolates presentation, routing, business logic, and AI inference. The stack is typed with `TypeScript`, ensuring strong contracts across the client‑server boundary while maintaining a lightweight, event‑driven architecture.
longDescription:
The platform follows a **layered architecture** separating concerns into distinct tiers. The **ClientTier** renders interactive UI components using **React** and **Next.js**, handling state synchronization via WebSocket connections. The **APITier** acts as an **HTTP request router** that upgrades connections to WebSocket streams, routing messages to appropriate service handlers.

In the **ServiceTier**, controller modules encapsulate domain logic for code editing, session management, and AI‑driven suggestions. Each controller is located under the `src/services` directory, promoting clear module boundaries and testability. The **DataEngineTier** hosts the **InferenceEngine**, a thin wrapper around the **Gemini AI** SDK, executing model inference in a sandboxed runtime to generate context‑aware code completions.

Security is enforced at multiple layers: the WebSocket handshake validates JWT tokens, and all inbound messages are sanitized before reaching the AI inference layer to mitigate injection attacks. The build pipeline utilizes **Vite** with **Vitest/Jest** for unit and integration testing, and `tsc` for type checking, ensuring that both client and server bundles remain type‑safe.

Deployment is container‑agnostic; while no explicit Docker configuration is present, the codebase is structured to be easily packaged into a Docker image, facilitating CI/CD integration. The overall topology enables horizontal scaling of the WebSocket gateway and AI inference workers, allowing the platform to handle concurrent collaborative sessions with low latency.

architectureOverview: Frontend built with React, Next.js. Backend API powered by WebSockets. AI/ML capabilities powered by Gemini AI.
userFlow: User Access & Preset Selection: User opens client interface and configures request parameters or task workflow presets.
Client Payload Dispatch: Front-end components (React, Next.js) serialize input objects and send HTTP/WebSocket requests to `/api/analyze`.
Middleware & Validation Check: API Gateway evaluates CORS headers, authorization tokens, and input validation schemas.
Service & Inference Execution: Service controllers dispatch request frames to model inference engine (Gemini AI) or storage layer.
Response Delivery & State Synchronization: Serialized output payload is returned to the client and rendered in the visual workspace.
codeFlow: Client or caller initiates request to application entrypoint
Backend router validates request parameters and applies middleware
Service layer delegates task to ML runtime or LLM API worker
Application serializes JSON/audio/data response back to client

remotionVideoScript.voiceoverScript: Welcome to the comprehensive 5-minute technical engineering deep dive into Aftercode. Section 1 System Topology: Engineered with TypeScript, JavaScript, combining a decoupled backend powered by WebSockets and client interface built with React, Next.js. Section 2 Static Code Analysis: AST code scanners inspect package manifests and component dependencies. Section 3 API Network Layer: Exposing 4 REST and WebSocket routes with parameter validation schemas. Section 4 Source Code Hierarchy: Codebase organized into isolated modules across Apps, App, Api, Components. Section 5 Intelligence & Persistence: AI inference accelerated by Gemini AI with persistence managed by PostgreSQL Storage. Section 6 Performance Metrics: Optimized with 1080p rendering and -16 LUFS loudness normalization. Section 7 Deployment & Outro: Explore the complete repository on GitHub at Sameer-Bagul slash Aftercode.
